cases.name: axis-aligned square
cases.why: The baseline. A square is 1:1, fills its own rectangle, and has the isoperimetric quotient pi/4.

reasons: 100 m2 of floor (storeys not known, counted as one) across 1 level: a shop, a house, a single hall.
A plain 100% rectangle: no plan features to lean on, so whatever makes it distinctive has to be put there.

No storey count in the source data, so this is a single-storey reading; a real multi-storey building would carry more.
